## `Button`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::Button`

```rust
pub struct Button { /* private fields */ }
```

A push button that runs `action`: `Button::new(t!("save"), move || …)`.
Without a variant or size of its own, it takes the environment's
`button_variant` and `control_size`.

#### Examples

```rust
let save = Button::new("Save", || println!("saved"))
    .variant(ButtonVariant::Outline);
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `Button::icon`

```rust
pub fn icon(self, icon: Icon) -> Self
```

An icon before the label, or the only content of an icon size.

#### `Button::loading`

```rust
pub fn loading<M>(self, loading: impl IntoLive<bool, M>) -> Self
```

Shows a turning loader in place of the leading icon while
`loading` is true. The button then looks disabled and ignores
activation.

```rust

```

A button with `label` that runs `action` when the user activates it.


The size of the button, instead of the environment's.

## `HeaderView`

struct in `choscorui::prelude::HeaderView`

```rust
pub struct HeaderView { /* private fields */ }
```

A table header over `columns`. A click or Space sorts by a column:
ascending, descending, then no sort. `sort` edits the sort. Dragging a
column edge, or `+` and `-`, resizes the column and runs `.on_resize`
with the new widths. The header keeps its widths when the columns
are made again, for example for a new locale.

#### Examples

```rust
struct Columns;

impl View for Columns {
    fn body(&self, cx: &mut Cx) -> impl View {
        let sort = cx.state(None);
        let columns = vec![HeaderColumn { title: "Name".into(), width: 160.0, min_width: 60.0 }];
        HeaderView::new(columns, sort.binding()).on_resize(|widths| println!("{widths:?}"))
    }
}
```

Modifiers: every [`ViewExt`](modifiers.md#viewext) method applies to this view.

### Methods

#### `HeaderView::new`

```rust
pub fn new(columns: impl Items<HeaderColumn>, sort: Binding<Option<(usize, SortOrder)>>) -> Self
```

A header of `columns`; `sort` edits the sort column and order.

#### `HeaderView::on_resize`

```rust
pub fn on_resize(self, action: impl Fn(Vec<f64>) + 'static) -> Self
```

Runs `action` with the column widths after the user resizes one.
